newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse ends session 0.40 pct higher.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse ends session 0.40 pct higher.

text.p: The Tunis stock exchange index on Monday closed 0.40 percent higher due largely to active trade, a bourse official said.
The 31-share index closed at 496.86 points from 494.88 points on Friday.
Volume was 2.78 million dinars against 1.03 million dinars over the previous session.
Chemical firm ICF gained 1.38 dinars to close at 47.62 dinars.
BTEI bank was up 0.12 dinar to 23 dinars.
Banque de l'Habitat fell 0.54 dinars to 20.5.
Banque de Tunisie declined 0.12 dinar to 74.9 dinars.
